question: Which statement best describes Polling?
options: With polling, the browser asks the server repeatedly whether something changed. It is simple to understand, but frequent requests can waste work. Use it when updates are infrequent or simpler infrastructure matters. It is like checking a mailbox every minute.

SSE keeps one HTTP connection open so the server can stream text updates to the browser. The direction is server to client. Browsers can reconnect automatically, which suits feeds and status notifications.

A WebSocket starts with an HTTP upgrade and then allows messages in both directions. It suits interactive products such as collaborative editing or multiplayer games. The application must define message types, reconnect rules, and authorization.

Networks drop. A live interface needs a reconnect policy, connection status, and a way to recover missed updates. Use message IDs or a fresh snapshot when gaps matter. A radio needs a plan for returning after the signal fades.
explanation: With polling, the browser asks the server repeatedly whether something changed. It is simple to understand, but frequent requests can waste work. Use it when updates are infrequent or simpler infrastructure matters. It is like checking a mailbox every minute.
